papers.title: Weak error estimates of a spectral Galerkin approximation to the stochastic Burgers equation driven by rough white noise
authors: Minxing Zhang, Yongkui Zou, Yanzhao Cao
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2611.22112v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In this paper, we investigate weak error estimates for a spectral Galerkin approximation to a stochastic Burgers equation driven by rough space-time white noise. The roughness of the driving noise results that the mild solution possesses only $L^\infty$-regularity rather than any positive-order differentiability order regularity. The theory of classical numerical analysis reveals that the convergence rate of numerical solution is determined by the smoothness of the exact solution, and hence $L^\infty$-regularity is insufficient to yield any positive convergence rate.
